name: jira-band
description: A row above the prompt showing the Jira ticket named in the current git branch

jiraUrl.title: Jira URL
jiraUrl.description: e.g. https://jira.example.com. Empty: the JIRA_URL environment variable. The token is read from JIRA_API_TOKEN.

jiraUser.title: Jira username
jiraUser.description: Set it for basic auth (username + JIRA_API_TOKEN, as Jira Cloud wants). Empty: the token is sent as a bearer personal access token (Jira Server/Data Center).
